nodes.name: Retention Settings
nodes.notes: Retention periods in days, read from the n8n variables auditRetentionDays, errorRetentionDays and paymentRetentionDays; change them there. Expected: audit 180, errors 365, closed payments 365, still to be confirmed by the FOI records owners (roadmap D1). Rows older than the cutoff are deleted permanently: export the tables first if the old rows must be kept.

nodes.name: Compute Cutoffs
nodes.notes: Why Code: a Set node can calculate the dates but cannot stop the run. A missing or invalid retention value must never reach a delete node.

nodes.name: Delete Old Audit Rows
nodes.notes: Deletes foi-process-audit rows created before the audit cutoff.

nodes.name: Delete Old Error Rows
nodes.notes: Deletes foi-execution-errors rows created before the error cutoff.

nodes.name: Closed Payment Statuses
nodes.notes: The only payment statuses that may be purged. Never add PENDING, ACTIVE or a *_PENDING_SIDE_EFFECTS status: those payments are still in progress.

nodes.name: Split Payment Statuses
nodes.notes: One item per status, because a data table delete cannot combine 'any of these statuses' with 'older than the cutoff'.

nodes.name: Delete Old Payment Rows
nodes.notes: Deletes foi-payment-sla rows of this status that were closed (completed_at) before the payment cutoff. Rows without completed_at are kept.

parameters.content:
## Developer Overview – FOI Audit Retention

**Purpose:** keeps `foi-process-audit`, `foi-execution-errors` and `foi-payment-sla` from growing without limit (the n8n Data Tables share an instance-wide size cap).

**Trigger:** every Sunday 2 AM UTC (workflow time zone `Etc/UTC`). `Retention Settings` reads the retention periods from the n8n variables `auditRetentionDays`, `errorRetentionDays` and `paymentRetentionDays` (expected: 180, 365 and 365 days, still to be confirmed by the FOI records owners). A missing variable stops the run before any delete.

**Processing:** `Compute Cutoffs` turns the periods into dates and stops the run before any delete if a period is not a whole number of at least 30 days. Keep it a separate node: a Set node cannot read a field that it creates itself, which made the cutoff equal to the run time and deleted every row.

Audit and error rows older than the cutoff by `createdAt` are then deleted. This is safe because nothing in the event flow reads these tables any more: duplicate and ordering checks and the failed-execution lookup use the API outbox in Postgres. The event payload stays in the outbox until its own retention (N8N_OUTBOX_SCRUB_AFTER_DAYS / N8N_OUTBOX_PURGE_AFTER_DAYS).

**Payments:** `foi-payment-sla` rows are deleted only when they are `PAID`, `CANCELLED` or `EXPIRED` and `completed_at` is older than the cutoff. `PENDING`, `ACTIVE` and `*_PENDING_SIDE_EFFECTS` rows are always kept. A payment that arrives after its `EXPIRED` row has been purged will not find a row.

**Failures** go to FOI Error Handler (error workflow).
